profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experience
▪ 5+ years of total experience in software development, including 3+ years specializing in ERP systems integration, cloud architecture, and enterprise applications
▪ Hands-on experience across logistics (TMS), sales systems, POS, RFID, and internal enterprise platforms, supporting large-scale business operations
▪ Proven ability to work in agile, cross-functional environments, collaborating with business stakeholders, vendors, and global teams 


Skills
▪ Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (EKS, EC2, S3), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
▪ Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Linux Professional (CompTIA Linux+)
▪ Backend: Python (Django), Java (Spring Boot), PL/SQL, RESTful API development
▪ Frontend: Flutter, React.js, React Native, Sencha Ext JS
▪ ERP & Enterprise Systems: SAP integration, Odoo, Oracle ERP, TMS
▪ DevOps & CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab, SVN, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch
▪ Databases: Oracle DB, PostgreSQL, SQL optimization & performance tuning
▪ AI & Data: LLM implementation (Llama3), Vector DB (FAISS), RAG architecture 


Career Highlights
▪ Led development of cross-platform enterprise applications that improved user experience and system performance by 20%
▪ Designed and implemented ERP and SAP integrations (POS, RFID, sales systems), reducing manual processes and cutting order processing time from 24 hours to 10 minutes
▪ Built and optimized API-driven architectures connecting internal systems with third-party vendors (UPS, logistics providers, RFID vendors)
▪ Delivered containerized, cloud-native solutions using Docker and AWS EKS, reducing deployment time by 40% through improved orchestration
▪ Developed AI-enabled internal services using LLMs and vector databases to enhance logistics data insights and operational efficiency
▪ Increased sales and administrative productivity by 20% through automation, system optimization, and ERP enhancements
▪ Acted as technical lead and project coordinator, bridging IT teams, business users, and external vendors to ensure successful system rollouts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Engineered and troubleshot ETL data pipelines using PL/SQL packages and procedures across a
complex, interconnected TMS environment, delivering reliable data to the Business Intelligence
platform while integrating REST APIs with UPS and third-party logistics providers (4PLs)
• Executed and maintained containerized applications leveraging Docker and AWS EKS, while
regulating team DevOps infrastructure including SVN version control
• Built AI-driven internal services on TMS data, leveraging Vector database (FAISS) with LLM and
LangGraph orchestration to retrieve, ground, and surface high-quality data results for logistics
decision support
• Designed a modern application architecture (React.js + Spring Boot microservices on Kubernetes/
AWS) and standardized framework for the team, cutting end-to-end development and
deployment cycles from 2-3 weeks down to ~1 week

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Port Washington, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
▪ Enhanced an internal B2B sales application, implementing 20+ frontend improvements via systematic updates
▪ Served as IT project manager, overseeing API integration between external vendors and internal ERP infrastructure
▪ Demonstrated understanding of sales operations and ERP systems to develop internal applications
▪ Ensured Monitored servers, applications, and cron jobs to ensure performance and support operational teams
▪ Contributed to backend development efforts utilizing the Odoo framework
▪ Improved Sales and Administrative teams' efficiency by 20% through automation of repetitive tasks
▪ Utilized AWS services to manage application deployment, configuration, and maintain high availability standards

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.locationName: Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
▪ Implemented security measures for local/cloud environments, including Active Directory management and file system protocols
▪ Optimized performance for users through hardware/software maintenance, issue analysis, and Tier 1 ticket resolution
▪ Analyzed cloud platform performance to drive optimization, while supporting MS Teams implementation

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
▪ Managed Laravel environment configurations and deployment processes for optimal web application performance
▪ Contributed to frontend development by integrating JS libraries to create responsive data grid designs

projects.title: RFID
projects.description:
▪	Developed API integration between external RFID vendor system and internal SAP infrastructure
▪	Designed and prototyped user-centric web application interfaces to enhance warehouse worker efficiency
▪	Implemented RFID software solutions for global affiliates, streamlining operational processes
▪	Developed comprehensive technical documentation to facilitate seamless system integration and knowledge transfer
▪	Orchestrated cross-functional collaboration as IT Project Manager, bridging internal teams with external vendors

projects.title: Internal Sales Application Frontend Revamp
projects.description:
▪	Optimized API connections and data architecture to enhance system efficiency and data integrity
▪	Implemented geospatial visualization features for management, leveraging geolocation and time-based data collection
▪	Developed cross-platform system using inAppWebView and JS Channel for Flutter, Sencha JS, and Odoo interaction
▪	Architected a resilient, loosely coupled system design, ensuring business continuity during SAP outages
▪	Established robust monitoring protocols utilizing AWS CloudWatch for real-time performance tracking and log analysis
